text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Glory in the Takarazuka Kinen went to 
Silence Suzuka, who pulled off a brilliant 
front-running getaway.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The venue is enveloped in roaring cheers 
praising Silence Suzuka, who ran a race 
worthy of her title as the "Otherworldly 
Escape Artist."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Witnessing the roaring crowd firsthand, 
Air Groove keenly felt that she was unable 
to surpass her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having lost her composure, she expressed 
enthusiasm for the Sapporo Kinen, yet 
walked away with feeble steps.
